verdict.rationale: A documented machine channel such as system accounts, transmitter programs or batch-provider enrollment is a fair question for a government company register, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only human-facing search, a web Publikations-Plattform for submitting publication orders, and structured data offered as a non-binding service. No system-to-system channel or published enrollment path appears; the llms.txt probe returned a 404.
